CustomField.description: The current status for this customer ID set by workflow and field update based on the Risk Stage of the associated At Risk Assessment
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The current status for this customer ID set by workflow and field update based on the Risk Stage of the associated At Risk Assessment. Risk Stage 0 = Not At Risk Risk Stage 1 - 4 = At Risk Risk Stage 5 = Retained Risk Stage 6 = Terminated
CustomField.label: Risk Status
